entries.description: Scan network ports to identify active services and listening endpoints.

Interfere with wireless communications via radio frequency interference.
Inject malicious scripts that reflect immediately off a server to a victim's browser.

Deceive targets via fraudulent communications to steal credentials or distribute malware.

Gain access to restricted systems or APIs without providing valid credentials.
Bypass mechanisms that restrict access to protected resources and functionalities.
Attempt to authenticate against a system using valid or compromised credentials.

Hide malicious code inside alternate file data streams to evade detection.
Create symbolic links to trick applications into modifying or reading critical files.

Execute malicious payloads by abusing shared modules or dynamic-link libraries loaded by applications.
